description: Ask for a full music royalties and registration review of a catalogue. Records the request (contact name, email, optional organisation, the catalogue's ISRCs and/or a description) so a person at TrackForge can follow up by email. It does not generate or send a report. Call it only when the user has asked for a follow-up and agreed to be contacted: consent_to_contact must be true.

catalogue_description.description: Free-text description of the catalogue, e.g. artist names, number of songs, territories.

consent_to_contact.description: True only if the user has agreed that TrackForge may contact them by email about this request.

email.description: Contact email address for the follow-up.

isrcs.description: ISRCs in the catalogue (up to 200). Give isrcs, catalogue_description, or both.

organisation.description: Optional label, publisher or company name.

name: request_full_report
title: Request a music royalties review (a person follows up)
